labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for new behaviour (unit styling in ReprHighlighter); feature requests need Discussions approval first.

body:
Thanks for the proposal. New features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start the proposal there.

You can already style units today by subclassing `RegexHighlighter` with your own pattern, as shown in the [highlighting docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst).

Related number-highlighting report: #3318.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
